title: Chrono Trigger
notes: Sprites only (22670 sprite images, 85% of them character sheets under Chara/). The game has no 3D textures and no NFTR fonts.

Field and town backgrounds are not in the pack. They are the SNES port's format: Map/Bg/Bg_*_ncg.bin tile sets and BgPlt_*_ncl.bin palettes (11 rows of 16 colours), laid out at runtime from PS_BIN/ChipTable (16x16 chips) and PS_BIN/MapTable (maps, compressed). Without parsing those the tool cannot tell which palette row a tile uses, so it has no key for it.
